gaps.needs: For a finite-dimensional right H-comodule M over a field F and v∈M, construct the least subcomodule containing v and prove its compatibility with every field extension K/F.

For a faithfully flat quotient G→Q of affine finite-type group schemes over a field with finite central kernel N, identify finite rational Q-representations with finite rational G-representations on which N acts trivially.

For a field F and commutative Hopf F-algebra H in a common universe, supply compatible essential smallness, monoidal preadditivity, F-linearity and finite-dimensional Hom spaces for the native finite-comodule category.
